snippet.title: Vital Shell - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
I’m really excited to announce Vital Shell, a science-fantasy survivor-like experience with a distinct PSX-era look, complete with an ambient jungle soundtrack. 

Take control of your favorite fantasy archetype expressed as a mech. Battle relentless waves of enemies in desolate, dream-like environments. Equip your Shell with unique weapons, traits, and powerful abilities, designing potent builds and synergies with every run.

WISHLIST NOW ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3741860/Vital_Shell?utm_source=youtube

https://linktr.ee/vitalshellgame

Music by: https://open.spotify.com/artist/1ZNcRJM6QUWh7NKGb5gSOO

Vital shell is expected to release at the beginning of next year.
